name: Luminescent Quantum-Flora Symphony
description: A luminescent quantum-flora bloom raymarched from smooth-union SDF primitives: a capsule stem, an audio-pulsing emissive core bulb, and a KIFS petal lattice whose fold count adapts to the Petal Complexity slider. A mouse-driven Gravity Twist swirls the growth field, Spore Density seeds a hex-tessellation spore lattice fed by real FFT bins, and Core Intensity drives the bloom's glow. Adaptive raymarch step counts, fold LOD, early exits, real depth and semantic alpha.
